verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a UI framework and its tooling, since frameworks and their CLIs often ship telemetry with opt-out controls, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out, so there is no evidence the capability exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
